Assignment sha256 567c7a2fc3be12cddb86a5160c185b4329a56942ba8eabc352648b675aee4849, checked at start. In this run I wrote no product implementation, test in the candidate, register row, ADR, handover text, repair or delivery decision, and I changed no candidate file. My new test is under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG7/qa/tests/, outside the candidate. Every execution ran in disposable clones under $TMPDIR, which I removed at the end.
